localOnly.headline: Micron earnings become the cleanest live test of the memory-scarcity thesis
localOnly.linkedTheme: US–China AI War / AI Abundance + Compute Sovereignty
localOnly.whyInteresting: Expectations are already very high, so the stock reaction can be more informative than the headline numbers. Strong operating evidence with a weak tape would create a useful expectation-versus-reaction divergence.
localOnly.bigPictureBridge: AI workloads → HBM/DRAM demand → memory pricing/supply → earnings and guidance → semiconductor breadth.

localOnly.headline: Iran says it received a U.S. response to its trust-building proposal
localOnly.linkedTheme: Refined Products / Diesel Inflation + Middle East Supply Risk
localOnly.whyInteresting: This is a fast-moving sentence-level catalyst for the energy complex because the negotiation path changes the probability of freer Hormuz traffic before inventories or company earnings change.
localOnly.bigPictureBridge: U.S.–Iran diplomacy → Hormuz shipping probability → crude/products/freight → inflation expectations → yields/USD → portfolio energy exposure.

localOnly.whyInteresting: Tesla's autonomy thesis now has a concrete regulatory scale gate, while its core vehicle-delivery outlook is also under scrutiny.
